name: OpenYabby
description: An open-source voice-driven multi-agent orchestration system for AI coding workflows. Integrates with Claude Code and other CLI runners to enable project-scale development through coordinated agents. Features persistent memory, multi-channel support (WhatsApp, Discord, Slack), and hierarchical agent teams for planning, execution, and review cycles.
community_quotes: Voice-driven multi-agent assistant for real project building on Mac
Combines Realtime API + CLI runners + multi-channel orchestration
Open-source alternative to closed AI assistants
Can create standalone research agents in WhatsApp with dedicated threads
Runner-agnostic: supports Claude Code, Codex, Aider, Goose, Cline, and Continue
